SEARCH
Package it.unipd.search.dto

Class Document

java.lang.Object
it.unipd.search.dto.Document
public class Document extends Object
Represents a document with identifying information, metadata, and textual content.

A documents instance encapsulates:

  • a unique identifier
  • a source URL
  • a title
  • the main textual content
  • associated topics or tags

Equality and hash code are defined based on the id and title fields, allowing consistent behavior when instances are used in collections such as HashSet or as keys in HashMap.

    • equals

      public boolean equals(Object obj)
      Indicates whether this document is equal to another object.

      Two documents objects are considered equal if and only if they are of the same class and have the same id and title.
